agent: Codex main session with two read-only MiniMax M3.1 Flash CCR audit workers
purpose: Determine whether frozen original SAMURAI and Netflix VOID initially contained multi-model fusion, distinguishing intra-model feature/memory fusion and sequential heterogeneous pipelines from ensemble fusion of multiple models' mask estimates.

samurai.conclusion: No multi-model fusion. Original SAMURAI adds a Kalman motion prior and memory-bank selection inside one SAM2 tracker.
evidence: third_party/sam2/sam2/modeling/sam2_base.py:420-498 scores three masks from one SAM2 multimask decoder, combines model IoU with Kalman-predicted box IoU at line 474, then argmax-selects one candidate at line 475; it never averages masks or logits from multiple models.
third_party/sam2/sam2/modeling/sam2_base.py:663-680 selects prior memory frames from the same tracker using best_iou_score, object_score_logits, and kf_score.
third_party/sam2/sam2/modeling/sam2_base.py:631 and memory_encoder.py:120 use 'fuse/Fuser' for current-frame/memory or pixel/mask feature fusion inside one SAM2 network.
All inference call sites construct exactly one SAM2 predictor and load one checkpoint.
A frozen-tree text search found zero ensemble/expert/multi-model/consensus/voting/weighted-mask hits; samurai_mode was used as the positive search control.

Legacy train_script_distill.py has teacher/student scaffolding, but it is dead in this snapshot (missing actors/modules), belongs to legacy ARTrack/STARK training, and is training-time distillation rather than inference mask fusion.

void.conclusion: No ensemble fusion, but the initial public release did contain a heterogeneous multi-stage mask reasoner: SAM2 primary segmentation, Gemini scene analysis, and SAM3-or-LangSAM affected-object segmentation, followed by deterministic semantic composition.
evidence: At fd90e40, stage2_vlm_analysis.py line 31 defaults to gemini-3-pro-preview.
At fd90e40, stage3a_generate_grey_masks.py line 371 exposes an exclusive --segmentation-model choice of sam3 or langsam; it does not run both.
At fd90e40, stage4_combine_masks.py lines 23-53 maps two semantic channels into 0/63/127/255 with equality tests: primary-only, affected-only, and overlap.

The initial Stage 1 uses SAM2 point-prompted video tracking for the primary black mask; Stage 2 uses Gemini to identify affected objects; Stage 3 selects one mask model for affected regions; Stage 4 composes the channels.
Pinned videox_fun/utils/utils.py:378-381 reads one prepared quadmask_*.mp4 file and the inpainting pipeline conditions one CogVideoX/VOID model on that tensor; there is no mask probability ensemble.

VOID Pass 1/Pass 2 are sequentially trained generative checkpoints. Pass 2 initializes from Pass 1 warped latents and writes a refined output; it does not blend mask predictions from independent experts.

verification.result: Hits were intra-model feature/memory fusion, Kalman candidate selection, per-object compositing, or evaluation averaging; no multi-model mask ensemble.

non_claims: This is source and commit provenance research, not execution of SAMURAI or VOID.
No evidence is claimed about unpublished branches, deleted upstream history, or papers whose methods are absent from the audited source.
The VOID heterogeneous pipeline is not equivalent to samurai's ensemble: its models fill different semantic roles and do not independently estimate the same primary mask for weighted fusion.
The cached trampoline sam3_masks directory still lacks a durable live-model invocation receipt and was not counted as proof of a live SAM3 expert.
